glosses: Montrer une mauvaise humeur en parlant, maugréant ; râler.

examples.text: Ceux qui avoient moyen portoient des royales [sorte de vêtement], mais les gens de pieds furent contraints de les laisser, ou rougner, car à tous coups les esperons s’engagoient dedans et faisoient faire des parterres.
Il rougne parce qu’il est contrarié.
Als die Urlaubssperre verkündet wurde, murrte alles.
Ein heraufziehendes Gewitter murrte im Südwesten.

glosses: A low thundering, rumbling or growling sound.
The sound made by a hungry stomach.

examples.text: That whiner is never without a grumble to share.

glosses: To make a low, growling or rumbling noise, like a hungry stomach or certain animals.

examples.text: The distant thunder grumbles.
It made his stomach grumble in protest to think the mule was eating, and here he was worrying about her with an empty belly of his own.

glosses: To complain; to murmur or mutter with discontent; to make ill-natured complaints in a low voice and a surly manner.

examples.text: He grumbles about the food constantly, but has yet to learn to cook.

glosses: To utter in a grumbling fashion.

examples.text: He grumbled that there was no grain "in the country" and that people were talking instead of working to provide it.

glosses: A low, mournful cry of pain, sorrow or pleasure.

examples.text: let out a deep moan
We heard the distant moan of a stag in pain.
to make one's moan

it shall be my daily grief and moan, that I am so dull, & do so little[…]But if when all is done that we can do, you will leave us nothing but our tears and moans for self-destroyers, the sin is yours, and the suffering shall be yours.

to thee therefore oh Lord do I make my moan, to thee I render my humble petition, and pour out my soul which hath sinned against thee: Oh Lord, I beseech thee for thy infinite mercy in Jesus Christ, to take pity upon mee[…]

glosses: To complain about; to bemoan, to bewail; to mourn.

examples.text: Much did the Craven seeme to mone his case […].

1708, Matthew Prior, the Turtle and the Sparrow
Ye floods, ye woods, ye echoes, moan / My dear Columbo, dead and gone.

glosses: To make a moan or similar sound.

examples.text: She moaned with pleasure and squirmed with delight from receiving oral sex.
They shared a common dread that he would begin moaning.

glosses: To say in a moan, or with a moaning voice.

examples.text: ‘Please don't leave me,’ he moaned.
which infinitely moans me
